overview:
proSapient is a London-based, technology-first expert network that was purpose-built around AI and machine learning from its founding in 2017. The company positions itself as the first expert network powered by machine learning AI technology, using semantic search and intelligent matching to connect clients with industry experts faster than traditional relationship-driven models.

The platform serves institutional investors, management consultants, and corporate professionals through expert consultations, surveys, transcripts, and executive placement services. proSapient has experienced rapid growth, reaching $55.8M in revenue and 100+ clients by 2024, and has been recognized among the Financial Times FT1000 fastest-growing businesses in Europe. With offices in London, Toronto, Raleigh, and Lisbon, and a technical development team in Kyiv, proSapient represents the newer wave of technology-led expert networks challenging established incumbents. Under CEO Aneil Rakity, with co-founder Margo Polishchuk serving as President, the company continues to expand its platform capabilities including AI-generated transcript summaries and translations in 48 languages.

history.narrative: proSapient was co-founded in 2017 by Margo Polishchuk and Jordan Shlosberg. Polishchuk came from an expert networking background and Shlosberg was a client — together they saw an opportunity to rebuild the expert network model from the ground up using AI and machine learning technology. The company raised seed funding and a $10M Series A led by Smedvig Capital, achieving rapid revenue growth and recognition as one of Europe's fastest-growing businesses.

servicesDetailed.name: Expert Consultations
servicesDetailed.description: One-on-one or group calls connecting clients with vetted industry experts. proSapient's AI-powered matching and automated scheduling aim to deliver faster expert access than traditional relationship-driven models, with typical turnaround measured in hours rather than days.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: B2B and B2C survey research using proSapient's expert network and broader respondent sourcing. The platform incorporates AI into its survey programming tools to accelerate the process from draft questionnaire to data collection. Surveys can be used standalone or paired with follow-up expert calls.

servicesDetailed.name: Transcripts
servicesDetailed.description: AI-powered speech-to-text transcription delivering 99% accuracy within 4 hours of call completion. Transcripts include AI-generated summaries and are available with AI translations in 48 languages. Compliance officers perform manual MNPI checks before approving each transcript. The searchable transcript library makes insights accessible and shareable for project collaboration.

servicesDetailed.name: Executive Placement
servicesDetailed.description: Connecting clients with senior industry professionals for advisory board roles, interim positions, and strategic consulting engagements beyond standard one-off expert calls.

servicesDetailed.name: Network Management Platform
servicesDetailed.description: A self-serve platform that allows clients to manage their own expert networks alongside proSapient's network. Features include dashboard views for performance monitoring, budget tracking, calendar integration, and automatic expert profile updates.

servicesDetailed.name: Messaging & Instant Connection
servicesDetailed.description: Direct messaging capabilities within the platform for quick follow-up questions and asynchronous communication with experts, reducing the need for formal scheduled calls.

aiPlatform.narrative: Technology and AI are central to proSapient's identity — the company was founded explicitly as an AI-first expert network. Its platform uses machine learning and semantic search to match client requests with relevant experts, moving beyond simple keyword matching to understand the contextual meaning of research questions. The technology stack also includes AI-powered transcription, automated scheduling, and AI-assisted survey tools.

complianceExtended.narrative: proSapient integrates compliance directly into its platform workflow rather than treating it as a separate manual process. Automated screening and vetting are built into the expert onboarding and matching pipeline, with manual review triggered for flagged cases. The platform maintains full audit trails of all interactions.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: proSapient operates under UK and EU regulatory frameworks with GDPR compliance for data protection and ISO 27001 certification for information security. The company has maintained a clean regulatory record since its founding in 2017. As a newer entrant, it has had the advantage of building compliance into its technology platform from the ground up rather than retrofitting legacy processes.

clientFit.narrative: proSapient is well suited for clients who value speed, technology-enabled workflows, and transparent pricing. The self-serve platform model appeals to teams that want direct control over expert sourcing and scheduling rather than relying entirely on managed-service intermediation. The company's growth among consulting and PE clients suggests strong product-market fit in mid-market professional services.

strengths: AI-first platform built from the ground up with machine learning at the core
Fast expert matching and scheduling — turnaround measured in hours
